Bachelor of Science
Computer Science

For the Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, a minimum of 127 credit hours is required. This requirement is in addition to credit received for algebra, trigonometry, and basic ROTC courses. An average of at least two grade points per credit hour must be attained. A "C" or better grade must be earned in each computer science course used to fulfill B.S. in computer science degree requirements as well as in COMP ENG 2210 and the required ethics elective.
